diagnostics.method: One first differing layer per reference bar: missing, voices, meter, unknown duration, notes, rhythm/rests, ties, validation. Counts are not independent root causes.
diagnostics.rhythm_method: Exact voice-0 beat durations, grace flags and attack/hold/rest presence with confirmed meter and validation. Ignores pitch and chord size; does not establish tempo, repeats, grace placement or audible timing.
diagnostics.pairing_caution: Consistency is an automatic check, not proof of matching editions. Keep both groups; do not use the supported subset as overall success.

limitations: Repeated regression corpus, not blind testing
Automatic pairing does not prove identical editions
Only explicit quarter-note tempo units with unambiguous bar-start placement are supported; dotted and other units remain blocked
Full-score core checks and MIDI timing do not establish complete effects, pitch curves or audible/device playback
Repeated corpus, not a blind test
Comparison requires exact source and destination bars; other notes remain unverified
Missing recognition is a coverage gap, not automatically proof of a new notation type
Unambiguous single-staff reference tracks only
